title: Quickly Baked Ukrainian Colby Jack Cheese Flatbread
description: A salty, crisp, and romantic Ukrainian dish featuring colby jack cheese and ferment kimchi, this jain friendly flatbread is perfect for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, salt, sugar, and yeast.
Gradually add the warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Transfer the dough to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the dough with olive oil and sprinkle with half of the colby jack cheese.
Top the cheese with chopped ferment kimchi.
Sprinkle the remaining colby jack cheese over the kimchi.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 15 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
